nodes.text: HMPV is a common respiratory virus that can cause cold-like symptoms.🤧 Most people recover within a week, but it can be more serious for infants, older adults, and people with weakened immune systems. #respiratoryvirus #cold #flu

nodes.author: shitalbhavar
nodes.text: Several HMPV variants are circulating in 2025.🧬 Scientists are studying these variants to understand how they spread and if they cause different symptoms. More research is needed! 🔬 #variants #science #research

nodes.author: shitalbhavar
nodes.text:
Protect yourself and others! Here are some tips to prevent the spread of HMPV:

Wash your hands often 🧼
Cover your coughs and sneezes 🧻
Stay home if you're sick 🏠 #prevention #healthtips #staysafe
